prompts.label: A · 典藏纸本
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / game-card art-direction comparison. Create ONE polished landscape presentation board with EXACTLY THREE upright flat front-facing cards in a single row. Output 1536 x 1024 landscape if possible. Matte charcoal background #171b22, clean generous margins, no perspective, no hands, no scenery, no watermarks, no game logos. Each card has complete 2:3 outer dimensions, same apparent size, fully visible edges, aligned top and bottom, no overlap. Outside each card put a clear Chinese rarity label above: left “史诗”, center “传说”, right “棱彩”. Top-left small scheme label as specified. Cards occupy about 80% of board height. Fixed top-left cost “2”. Inside every card print card name EXACTLY “元素爆裂”, type EXACTLY “法术”, and readable dark Chinese rules on an ivory lower reading panel EXACTLY “对随机敌人造成2点法术伤害；本牌的伤害效果触发4–5次。” Keep these four values IDENTICAL on all three cards. The lower reading panel remains uncluttered. Reference image 1 is the LOCKED source illustration, not just a mood reference: reproduce the same five small dark human silhouettes in blue/red/orange/yellow/turquoise elemental explosions on warm gray, same diagonal arrangement, same broad opaque block-painted marks, no new character, no character portrait. Repeat the SAME painting inside all three cards, preserving all five explosion figures. All frames and embellishments must share the illustration’s opaque hand-painted broad planar brushwork, controlled edges, selective highlights, no photoreal 3D plastic. Rarity must be obvious from static material mass, silhouette and a single main emblem, even at small card size. Avoid tiny repetitive flourishes, excessive jewels, huge bloom, illegible text, stars as rarity ratings, cropped corners, scrapbook tape, ragged scrap layers, source-game logos. This is a PREVIEW board, not a screenshot or a finished game implementation.
SCHEME A — print scheme label “A · 典藏纸本”. Interpret as rare museum-bound art folios, ivory laid paper, restrained archival luxury. Supporting reference image 2 is ONLY the current paper frame’s painterly craft language: improve it radically; remove tape and ragged torn strips. Keep art upper about 56%, reading area lower 44%. EPIC left: deep aubergine fabric mounting visibly wider than the low-tier paper, clean silver foil inset, substantial four folded corners, one crisp silver diamond seal at top center. LEGENDARY center: a confident continuous warm gold leaf rim, thin near-black recessed inner mount against ivory paper, symmetrical substantial sun medallion top center, refined gold corner construction, warm strong light-dark metal planes. PRISM right: pearl-white archival mount with silver foil, restrained cyan-violet iridescent foil patches confined to bevels, a separated crystalline four-point star seal hovering just above the top edge, clear double-layer silhouette. Increasing luxury, NOT increasing tiny clutter. Strongest contrast is between rich dark mount and clean ivory. Retain physical paper and painted warmth.
